messages:
Tara Nguyen: Quick thread  BeaconHealth is asking to convert their hosted plan into a 2-year committed contract with a Dedicated GPU add-on. They want price protection, 8% multi-year discount, Net60 payment terms (they insist), and EU billing to 'BeaconHealth GmbH'. Also flag: their legal team requires wet-signing in Germany and an optional security questionnaire before go-live.
Ethan Brooks: 8% multi-year is within policy only with finance approval and signed commitment. Net60 is higher risk for us; need credit check + AP contact. What9s the committed ARR with the Dedicated add-on?
Tara Nguyen: Breakdown: base hosted = $150k/year, Dedicated add-on = $90k/year. With 2-year commit = $480k total before discount. They asked to lock pricing for both years.
Rosa Müller: Legal: wet-sign is unusual but doable for EU entities. We'll prepare a wet-sign addendum with notarization clause and German-language signature page. Need billing entity legal name, tax ID, and signing authority. Also will include a clause: "pricing protection subject to force majeure and hardware price increases >20%."
Samir Patel: Sales ops: if we accept Net60 we must set up automatic credit hold triggers and require PO for each renewal invoice. Also need to ensure vendorcode matches EU billing entity. Can we get BeaconHealth to provide PO and corporate credit reference?
Helena Ortiz: Security: before we move Dedicated infra, we need them to complete the quick security attestation. I uploaded the questionnaire link: https://security.redwood/internal/questionnaires/beacon-quick-scan. If they can9t finish before infra provisioning, we can delay provisioning but not the contract execution.
onboarding-bot: Provisioning checklist created: PROV-1812348910 (link: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/PROV-1812348910) - requires SSO mapping, dedicated cluster sizing, and infra-security signoff.
Ethan Brooks: Finance conditionally approves 8% discount and Net60 if: 1) they provide PO referencing INV-9001, 2) finance receives credit application (we have a template), 3) Escrow clause for payments >$200k per invoice is reviewed. If any of these fail we revert to Net30 or require upfront deposit.
Tara Nguyen: I9ll ask them for PO, tax ID (DE123456789), and AP contact tonight. They said wet-sign will be done at their Munich office and will take ~7 business days.
Rosa Müller: I9ll draft EU wet-sign addendum and include language for prorated termination if they fail to pay within 45 days after Net60. Also adding signature block in German + English.
Samir Patel: Operational note: Dedicated capacity onboarding window is 3-4 weeks after paperwork and security attestation. If they need earlier access we can discuss temporary burst capacity on hosted while the Dedicated infra is prepared.
Tara Nguyen: Customer prefers to start Dedicated Jan 15, 2025. I9ll share DocuSign for the US-standard docs and arrange wet-sign for the EU signature page. Keeping this thread updated as I get PO/attestation. :eyes:
